# watchpoint_maintenance_calendar_feed (Resource)

Creates maintenance windows from an ICS calendar (Outlook, Google Calendar, any iCal feed), polled on a schedule. Destroying the feed deletes its future scheduled windows. Requires the maintenance calendar sync feature and `monitors.update`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_maintenance_calendar_feed" "change_calendar" {
  name                  = "Change calendar"
  url                   = var.change_calendar_ics_url
  scope_type            = "group"
  scope_value           = watchpoint_monitor_group.payments.id
  summary_contains      = "[maintenance]"
  poll_interval_minutes = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name (120 characters max).
- `scope_type` (String) What the synced windows cover: `group`, `tag`, `service` or `monitors`.
- `scope_value` (String) The group ID, tag, service ID, or comma-separated monitor IDs, matching `scope_type`.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) ICS feed URL (`https://` or `webcal://`). Sensitive and write-only: the API returns only its host (`url_host`), so a URL changed outside Terraform is not detected.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether syncing is on. Defaults to `true`.
- `notify_on_end` (Boolean) Notify when a synced window ends. Defaults to `true`.
- `notify_on_start` (Boolean) Notify when a synced window starts. Defaults to `true`.
- `poll_interval_minutes` (Number) Minutes between polls, 5 to 1440. Defaults to `15`.
- `summary_contains` (String) Only events whose summary contains this text become windows.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Feed ID.
- `url_host` (String) Host of the stored feed URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_maintenance_calendar_feed.change_calendar mcf_0192f0c1
```
